conflicts.issue: ProductPM requires customer notice before release and support approval/on-call readiness, while BackendOwner only requires preserving code behavior. Resolved by placing customer notice and support prep before rollout.

SRE requires the JS/TS path to remain behind a runtime flag and stable for 24h before release, while BackendOwner wants code changes shipped without changing CLI. Resolved by implementing the runtime-flagged path and validating stability before release.
DataPlatform requires small-batch JS/TS scanning to avoid IOPS spikes, while SRE requires a 24h stability gate. Resolved by validating in controlled runs before broader rollout.

DataPlatform prohibits storage/layout changes during business hours, while ProductPM wants rollout within customer-notification and support windows. Resolved by scheduling rollout outside business hours and approved release windows.
ProductPM wants announcement before release, while Security requires dependency rollout to complete security review first. Resolved by performing security review before any external announcement.

ConsumerSubsystem requires end-to-end TS validation before cutover, while ProductPM wants support and customer notice prepared before release. Resolved by doing validation first, then communications, then release.
ConsumerSubsystem allows a 2-release-cycle dual-support window, while SRE requires a 24h error-rate gate before release. Resolved by keeping the rollout gradual and gated by SRE monitoring.

DataPlatform wants deprecated artifact removal only after 7 days of no reads, while Security is focused on safe fallback and dependency rollout. No direct ordering conflict on the main rollout; artifact deletion is deferred and excluded from this plan.
